entry.title: Hello World
entry.content:
This is the first post on my new blog. I’ll be writing about machine learning, systems engineering, and research topics I find interesting.

Why a blog here?

I already publish to Medium, but I wanted a space that lives alongside my portfolio — no paywalls, full control.

What to expect

Posts on topics like:

  • ML systems and infrastructure
  • Security engineering
  • Research I find worth unpacking
  • Things I built and what I learned

Stay tuned.
